title: Make Lookup
prompt: A TypeScript feature flag system wants lookup by key. Write a function that turns an array of entries into an object where each key maps to its enabled boolean.

explanation.beginner: Start by identifying what the function receives and what it must return. For Make Lookup, read the story as a simple input-to-output rule: A TypeScript feature flag system wants lookup by key. Write a function that turns an array of entries into an object where each key maps to its enabled boolean. Work through one small example by hand, then write the steps in TypeScript using plain variables before worrying about making the code shorter.
explanation.junior: Treat this as a small pure TypeScript function: avoid mutating inputs unless the prompt explicitly asks for it, return the requested shape exactly, and let the tests drive the edge cases.
